caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a long-sleeved shirt, centered on a plain, beige background. The shirt is primarily rendered in pencil with very light shading, suggesting a white or light-colored fabric. The shirt has a high, pointed collar and is adorned with a dark, nearly black bow tie at the neck. Three small buttons, shaded in light pink, run down the center front of the shirt, set within a panel with vertical pleats on either side, indicated by fine parallel lines. The sleeves are loose and gathered at the cuffs, each cuff being defined with straight lines and a single button. There is also a horizontal rectangular detail placed below the buttons and pleats. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a faint, smaller sketch of the back view of the shirt, showing the gathered fabric at the back yoke and the continuation of the cuffs. The overall composition is minimalistic, focusing attention on the shirt, with no other objects or background elements present.
title: Man's Miniature Shirt
